title: ‘Honey Please’: The Steep Rise and Sudden Fall of Kimberly Guilfoyle.
summary: President Trump cut her loose after damaging news reports about her tenure as ambassador to Greece. Once a prominent Trump insider, she suggested she will now fight to defend her reputation.
